ltpgtltspan style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif font-size: 11pt"gtUNDSS security staffing is very limited considering the extent of operational activities in the country.nbsp Various activities and security support could be delivered more comprehensively and effectively with additional resources.nbsp The proposed action plan is intended to provide increased analytical and operational capability at the country level to enhance security awareness, emergency preparedness and support for humanitarian operations in Ethiopia.nbsp To achieve these objectives, the proposed action includes funding for the staffing of a Security Information and Operations Centre (SIOC) in Addis Ababa. The SIOC will eliminate the existing gap in situational awareness and operational planning, it will also significantly aid the analytical support to field operations with an increased focus on safety and security, that allows maximum humanitarian access to vulnerable populations.nbsp UNDSS is also proposing to enhance its operations in the following areas: Nekemte, Dollo Ado, Gode, Kebridehar, and Jijiga in order to provide the necessary security support, assistance, assessment, and advice to all UN agencies, funds, programmes, NGOs, INGOs and all other partners present and operating in Ethiopia.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif font-size: 11pt"gtnbsplt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-size:11.0ptfont-family:" lang="EN-GB"gt ltspan style="color:blackbackground:white"gtThere was a very specific gap which prompted this project as UNDSS was previously funded by extra budgetarynbspfunding in the Somali region of Ethiopia provided by USAID, the funding for this area came to an end in March 2023 after several years of receiving steady funding for the operations of UNDSS in this area.nbsp UNDSS began exploring additional funding options in order to be able to continue providing security support to UN agencies, funds, and programmes in this region, as well as to support humanitarian partnersnbspas well.nbsp Due to the cessation of extra-budgetarynbspfunding in the Somali region, UNDSS has had to scale back operations, to some extent, and has had to conduct cost-sharing operations with other UN AFPs in order to ensure that the necessary and essential UNDSSnbspsecurity support could still be provided in this region.nbspnbspUNDSS also made the decision to not recruit two UNDSSnbspstaff that hadnbspresigned from their positions in the Somali region but instead decided to have our remaining staff present in the Somali region cover the gaps until such a time that additional funding could be secured and/or made available.lt/spangtlt/spangtltspan style="font-size:11.0pt font-family:"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltpgtltspan style="background-color: white"gtltfont color="#000000" face="Calibri, sans-serif"gtltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gtThis project would enable UNDSS to be able to fill the two vacant posts of UNDSS staff lt/spangtthatltspan style="font-size: 11pt"gtnbsphave resigned in the Somali regionnbspand would also enable us to expand to Nekemte in order to best support project partners with the critical and essential security support services that UNDSS provides.lt/spangtlt/fontgtlt/spangtlt/pgt
